title: Chapter 712
text:
Through the players' forums and the army's internal program, the players in the other bases also learned about the discount.

More than ten days later, more than a million army players gathered at the army headquarters and chose to participate in the war.

Quite a number of them fell for the promotion and handed over their wallets. Within half a month, the Black Star Army had earned a few billion in net profit, which was extremely generous.

However, the players were still mainly focused on leveling up. For example, the professional players were focused on leveling up in the early stages of the version, and only a small portion of them chose to learn more knowledge.

However, Han Xiao was not discouraged. When the players became rich in the future, they would definitely buy all the knowledge in the army with the excess EXP. This EXP would be in his pocket sooner or later. Just the EXP gained in half a month was already more than the total EXP he gained in the past seven years. His efficiency was off the charts.

The players happily enjoyed their new equipment, while Han Xiao happily counted his money.

In half a month, he had raised himself to level 217, and he was only three levels away from the level 220 Promotion.

After this wave of harvest, the players' savings and experience were basically emptied. They needed time to recover.

"The players' savings are still too little. That's true. At the end of the previous version, many people went to the Pro League to join in the fun and used their experience to level up their skills. This group of people did not save much experience, so I have to fatten them up first."

At this time, in the lounge of the conference room, a group of officers was shouting around the card table. Han Xiao leaned on the sofa and did not participate. He was alone and focused on the problem.

"After this battle, I should be able to gather enough experience for my Promotion. Maybe I can level up a few more times and shorten the gap between Beyond Grade A and Beyond Grade A."

Han Xiao pondered.

Although he would not reach Beyond Grade A so quickly, Han Xiao was quite satisfied with his current progress. The other Beyond Grade A seeds could not find a way to become Beyond Grade A and were stuck at a bottleneck. However, he only needed to level up, and he would be able to grow quickly. There was no real bottleneck.

Not to mention, he still had Mission Completion Cards. As long as he had enough experience, success would follow naturally.

While Han Xiao was deep in thought, a burst of cheers came from the other side of the table.

Lagi had a helpless expression on his face as he muttered, "I knew that I would definitely lose." He then stood up and left his seat. His side was completely defeated, and on the other side of the table was Reynold. His back was straight, and his expression was serious. He slightly nodded as if he was saying, "Thank you for letting me win."

"Not bad. Our logistics manager has won five matches in a row and killed five people."

"Tsk, I lost 50,000 Enas. If I had known, I would have bought Reynold."

"Vice Captain was tortured the entire time. His skills are too weak."

"A Mechanic's logic is indeed impressive … but why is His Excellency Black Star so bad at cards?"

"Teacher! Someone's talking bad about you! "Sylvia turned around and shouted at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao came back to his senses and walked behind Sylvia with his hands behind his back. He bent down and placed his chin on top of Sylvia's head. He then looked at everyone with an expression that said, "Let me see who's talking bad about me behind my back.jpg".

Because most of the officers would be participating in the battle a few days later, the backbone of the army was basically on standby at the headquarters. Just now, Han Xiao had a short meeting, and after it ended, everyone came to the lounge to play cards and gamble. They were like a group of brothers.

Han Xiao refused to participate in any activities that depended on luck.

Reynold was originally looking at the blueprints at the side, but Sylvia could not take it anymore after losing a few matches in a row and insisted on dragging Reynold over to vent her anger for her.

Although Reynold did not like to waste time on entertainment like Wayne Cards, he would occasionally be invited by others to play cards, and he also had his own deck of cards.

If he did not know how to play Wayne Cards, he would be too embarrassed to be an officer in the Black Star Corps.

Although the officers of the army had great strength, when they were not dealing with matters or fighting, they had their own interests like ordinary people and liked to have fun.

Since he was going to play, Reynold treated it seriously as usual. He had a strong logical ability, and his card skills had always been very strong. He had a lot of ways to play Wayne Cards, and after he was done with all kinds of tricks, he only needed to defeat his opponents. He defeated five opponents in a row and did not show any mercy to his sister, Rossellin.

Reynold slowly put away his cards and looked around. He was expressionless and looked extremely arrogant. "Who else?"

Sylvia raised her head and nudged Han Xiao's chin. "Teacher, why don't you play a round too?"

Harmon said honestly, "I bet that Black Star will lose. It's a sure win."

"Sure." Han Xiao snorted. "I'll kill whoever beats me. Who wants to play with me?"

"No, no."

Everyone waved their hands. You're the boss, you're the best. We don't dare to play.

Reynold knocked on the table lightly and said solemnly, "If no one wants to play with me, I'll be leaving."

This time, Herlous stood up and sat down across from Han Xiao. He sneered and had an expression that said, "I'll take you on."

"You're very arrogant. I'll let you understand what true skill is."

Reynold was expressionless. "You want to let me know what true luck is, right?"

"Humph, strong luck is also a type of skill."

Herlous snorted.

"It's over. Reynold's winning streak is going to end."

"What are you panicking for, Reynold? Punish this b * stard."

Everyone was in high spirits.

After seven years of training, Herlous had finally stepped through the threshold of Calamity Grade. His talent was indeed better than others, and he was indeed someone with the halo of a main character. It was as though he had suddenly become Grade A while playing cards.

Among all the officers, Herlous was the most passionate about Wayne Cards, and he would beat anyone he caught. Because the victory usually belonged to the Lucky Draw Association, and Fu Ding did not like to play cards, Herlous had an authoritative position in the Black Star Corps' Wayne Cards world.

Even the players knew that Herlous did not reject anyone. Even they could find Herlous to play cards with, and there was even a corresponding mission. If they beat Herlous in Wayne Cards, they would be rewarded with EXP and a chance to win a rare card from Herlous.

After exchanging a few words, Herlous and Reynold officially played. Both of them had brought the Black Star Corps card deck.

Five years ago, the Wayne Cards had been updated. Now that the Black Star Corps was affiliated to Floating Dragon Island, the number of cards on the list exceeded Floating Dragon Island. There were a total of eight cards, and Han Xiao's personal card had been strengthened. It had many special effects and extremely high health. It had already become a rare card.

Not long after, Herlous continuously drew cards. Although Reynold's card skills were very good, he still fell into a passive position.

Han Xiao suddenly had a bad taste and threw a [Luck Curse] at Herlous.

"Humph, you're already dead." Herlous confidently drew cards. He glanced at it, and his face stiffened.

Wayne Cards could be called luck identification, and the Luck attribute was the most obvious in card play. Even with ninety percent less Luck, Herlous' Luck was still higher than his. However, in front of Reynold, he did not have the buff of the Luck Glow, and all of his moves were wasted. Reynold easily counterattacked, and the situation quickly turned around.

"Yo, your luck finally ran out?"

"Haha, to think that you would have such a day."

Herlous' face darkened, and he defended himself. "What do you know? This is called strategically giving up an advantage. I'll make a comeback later."

The surrounding people laughed, and the room was filled with a cheerful atmosphere.

Han Xiao did not join in the fun anymore. He sat back on the sofa and opened the forums to observe the recent movements of the players.

Version 3.0 had only been released for less than half a month, and the players of the other Star Fields were still exploring. However, the information that Han Xiao revealed became important clues for the players of the other Star Fields to find their own Main Storyline, benefiting all the players.

This time, the Main Storyline of the new version in the Shattered Star Ring was the first to appear again. The players of the other Star Fields were envious, and the Shattered Star Ring section of the forums was the most active. Many players from the other Star Fields came to leave comments and discuss.

Coincidentally, Pork Bun released a new series of videos, guessing that the Black Star Corps was the hidden Main Storyline of the three versions in the Shattered Star Ring. He gave all kinds of analysis and praised Han Xiao crazily, causing a lot of discussion. Han Xiao and the Black Star Corps became a hot topic in the past half a month.

Han Xiao glanced at the posts. They were basically all discussing his importance and past. Pork Bun gave him a sense of presence, which was not a bad thing.

What made him happy was that the new episode of Galaxy Times, apart from introducing the new version, focused on the benefits of the Black Star Corps based on the players' information.

Coincidentally, there would be a large number of new players in Version 3.0. Galaxy Times highlighted the benefits of the Black Star Corps, which would attract many people to choose to be born in the Shattered Star Ring, indirectly increasing the number of players there.

"Knowledge can only be learned once, and those new players are a new market that can bring new benefits. Other than Blue Star, there are new novice planets in the Shattered Star Ring. I'll find some time to build a Black Star Corps base there and accept these new players into the army in advance."

Han Xiao pondered. Other than the core players who had been playing since Version 1.0, he had to increase the scale of his leek farm.

"The players of the other Star Fields are also a huge potential market. It's a pity that the distance between the Star Fields is too far, and the Black Star Corps cannot leave the Shattered Star Ring. There's no hope for now."

Han Xiao shook his head. He had always been eyeing the players of the other Star Fields, but due to the distance, he could not do anything to them.

Casually browsing through the posts, Han Xiao's eyes suddenly paused. A post caught his attention.

The title was' The Real Gameplay of the Secret War '.

"What the hell is the Real Gameplay? Why don't I know about it?"

Han Xiao clicked on it curiously. The ID of the poster was' Summer Night Flowers', and the content of the post made Han Xiao raise his brows.

"… The secret war main storyline allows you to choose between two factions. This is something that everyone already knows. However, we are in the Black Star Corps, and basically everyone was on the side of the Amethyst Civilization from the start. Since that's the case, why can we still choose the Klent faction? I think that there is a hidden hint in this.

The hint is that the benefits of joining Klent are much greater than staying in the Black Star Corps!

This is the correct way to play this main storyline!

"I'm not spouting nonsense. The first reason is that I've looked into the past ten years. From the start of the secret war, the Bloodshed Land had the advantage, and even now, they still have the initiative. They have invaded more and more regions, and according to the trend, Klent's chances of winning are much higher than Purple Crystal's.

"Based on the example of the Germinal Organization and the Mutation Disaster, I concluded that the higher the level of the conflict in the main storyline, the less influence we, the players, have on the storyline.

"The secret war is a battle between two Star Cluster civilizations, and I don't think that we can decide the outcome of the war.

"In other words, according to the trend, Klent is the side that will win this secret war!

Although staying in the Black Star Corps gave them many benefits, they would fail the main storyline mission at the end, and their evaluation would be lowered. If they joined Klent, even if they did not do anything, their evaluation of the main storyline mission would increase because they won the war.

"The second reason is that almost no one has joined Klent, which means that the competition is very small, and they have the opportunity to obtain more resources and opportunities. On the other hand, the Black Star Corps has millions of players. With so many of them fighting for kills, resources, and missions, they obviously have to put in more effort to obtain decent rewards.

"The third reason is the connection with the future version. According to the data, Klent's backer is the Red Empire, and the Red Empire is one of the three Universal Civilizations in the Galaxy. The future version is very likely to revolve around Universal Civilizations. Therefore, joining Klent is equivalent to opening the ladder to Universal Civilizations.

"No matter how powerful the Black Star Corps is in the future, they will never surpass Universal Civilizations.

"Therefore, from the way I see it, staying in the Black Star Corps will only allow us to enjoy the benefits in front of us, but we will lose more opportunities. Maybe the benefits of the Black Star Corps are a trap, and only smart people will be able to see through it and choose Klent!"

After reading the post, Han Xiao's expression was very strange.

He knew this player called 'Summer Night Flower'. In his previous life, Summer Night Flower was a famous person who discovered hidden storylines. He was passionate about analyzing storylines and had a good imagination, so he was quite famous.

Honestly speaking, Summer Night Flower's analysis was indeed very logical and logical. His attitude of 'I am the only one who is clean when the world is dirty' seemed to be true at first glance.

However, Summer Night Flower was completely wrong. All of this was purposely made up by Han Xiao. There was no 'hidden hint' at all.

If someone really believed it and went to join Klent, the consequences would be terrible just thinking about it.

Han Xiao had a helpless expression. Imagination is one thing, but you still have to follow the rules.
